appTagline: Internal requests, tracked end to end

items.title: Warehouse scanner firmware rollback
items.description: Units on the Leeds floor are dropping barcode reads after the 4.2 update. Roll back to 4.1.7 across all 38 handsets.

items.title: Contractor onboarding takes 9 days
items.description: Background check and laptop provisioning run sequentially. Overlap them to get new contractors productive inside a week.

items.title: Duplicate invoices from the Rotterdam supplier
items.description: Finance matched 14 duplicate payments last quarter. Needs a dedupe check before payment release.

items.title: Night shift cannot reset their own passwords
items.description: Helpdesk closes at 18:00 so night shift waits until morning. 60+ tickets a month, all the same.

items.title: Consolidate the three shipping dashboards
items.description: Ops, Finance and the depot managers each maintain their own version and the numbers disagree by about 4%.

items.title: Forklift inspection log is still on paper
items.description: Compliance needs 12 months of history retrievable in under a minute. Currently a binder in the depot office.

items.title: Returns portal rejects valid order numbers
items.description: Orders placed before the migration use a 7-character reference the portal regex does not accept.

items.title: Approval chain stalls on annual leave
items.description: Requests over 10k need a director signature with no delegate configured. Median wait during August was 11 days.

items.title: Stock counts drift between depots
items.description: Manual transfers are logged at the sending depot but not the receiving one. Reconciliation eats two days a month.

items.title: Driver app drains battery before end of route
items.description: GPS polls every two seconds regardless of movement. Drivers carry power banks as a workaround.

items.title: New starters cannot find the safety induction
items.description: The induction lives on a SharePoint page nobody links to. 30% complete it late.

items.title: Purchase orders exported by hand every Friday
items.description: Someone copies 200 rows into a spreadsheet and emails it to the supplier. It has been wrong twice this year.

items.title: Cold chain alerts go to a shared inbox
items.description: Temperature excursions email a mailbox nobody owns overnight. Two spoilage incidents last quarter.

items.title: Vendor risk reviews have no reminder
items.description: Annual reviews are tracked in a personal calendar. Four lapsed without anyone noticing.

items.title: Depot wifi drops at shift changeover
items.description: Roughly 90 devices reconnect at once and the access points fall over for two minutes.

items.title: Overtime is approved after it is worked
items.description: No pre-approval step, so budget overruns surface in the month-end close.

items.title: Customer address changes do not reach the depot
items.description: Updates land in the CRM but the pick list is generated from a nightly snapshot taken beforehand.

items.title: Damaged goods photos are lost in chat
items.description: Drivers post to a group chat that rolls over. Claims later have no evidence attached.

items.title: Two systems disagree on who is a manager
items.description: HR and the access system drift apart, so leavers keep approval rights for weeks.

items.title: No single view of a request once submitted
items.description: Requesters email for updates because there is nowhere to look. Roughly 40 chase emails a week.
